lead_raw_text:
The tetragonal V₂Cr₄S₈ phase (reduced formula VCr₂S₄, space group I-4m2, No. 119) has 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cr centers in octahedral environments with six S neighbors (2.405–2.457 Å), V centers in tetrahedral environments with four S neighbors (2.295–2.296 Å), and S centers with six neighbors (two Cr and four V). The neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Cr octahedra and V tetrahedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Cr octahedra.
